bio.text: Zebulon Featherly is an independent candidate for Michigan's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Houghton, Michigan, graduated from Houghton High School, attended Eastern Michigan University and graduated from the North Western Renewable Energy Institute in 2017.

He has worked as an electrician and wind turbine technician; in his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey responses he says he was born and raised in northern Michigan and is now an apprentice electrician.
